about_the_game:
Welcome to Tavernia — the fantasy tavern where every night is a battle between order and chaos. As the tavern keeper, your task seems simple: serve drinks, talk with your customers  and keep the tables from flipping. In reality, your tavern is a magnet for rowdy knights, reckless rogues, drunken orcs, and creatures who definitely don’t understand the concept of “last call.”

Tavernia is a single-player comedy simulator that blends management with mayhem. You’ll juggle pouring drinks, calming down brawls, fixing magical accidents, and making sure your tavern doesn’t burn to the ground. Every shift is unpredictable, every customer a new challenge, and your only tools are quick thinking and a good sense of humor.

Upgrade your tavern, hire (and manage) eccentric staff, and decide how to deal with unruly guests. Will you try to run a respectable establishment, or embrace the madness and let your tavern become the wildest spot in the kingdom? The choice  and the chaos  is yours.

With a stylized, colorful art style and plenty of comical disasters waiting to happen, Tavernia ensures no two nights are ever the same. Pour, manage, survive, and most importantly… have fun while everything falls apart around you.

content_descriptors.notes:
Alcohol Fermentation, Selling & Consumption, Goofy Cartoon Violence, Mature Language, Profanity, Themes of Racism among Fantasy Races, Fighting & Stealing 
Game is about running a bar, so all the events, cursing profanity etc.. are random encounters chosen from a pool with various triggers. 

Races are Fantasy races like Human, goblin, dwarvef, elves, orcs vampires etc..

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM)

  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
